title: Double Chocolate Chip Cookies
description: Because plain chocolate is for lightweights. Soft, fudgy, and packed with chocolate chips — perfect with a cold glass of milk.

method.instruction: Preheat oven to 180°C. Line baking trays with baking paper.
Cream butter and both sugars until smooth and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time, then stir in vanilla extract.
Sift together flour, cocoa powder, bi-carb soda, and salt. Fold into the wet mixture until just combined.
Fold in dark and white chocolate chips until evenly distributed.
Drop spoonfuls of dough onto the prepared trays, leaving enough space for spreading.
Bake for 10–12 minutes. Let cookies rest on the tray for 5 minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely.

notes.title: Soft Cookie Secret
notes.content: Slightly underbaking gives the softest, fudgiest centre. The cookies will continue to set on the hot tray after coming out of the oven.

notes.title: Storage
notes.content: Keep in an airtight container for up to 5 days. Cookie dough can be frozen in balls and baked from frozen — add 2 minutes to the baking time.
